nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Tokens flow Primitive (raw values) -> Semantic (purpose aliases) -> Component (component-specific) so the semantic layer enables theme switching (light/dark) and component tokens enable per-component customization without ever hardcoding raw hex values in components.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Token System

nodes.label: Duarte Sparkline Pattern
nodes.rationale: Alternates 'What Is' (current pain) and 'What Could Be' (better future) slides, with pattern breaks at the 1/3 and 2/3 positions in a deck, to create engagement peaks and drive emotional transformation toward a 'New Bliss' resolution.
